_schema.description: L2 range-search groundtruth. For each query we computed its L2 distance to every base vector and counted how many fall within the L2 radius (radius_l2). Both the grand total and the per-query counts are persisted; per-query counts are also printed to stdout.

fields.metric: Distance metric (fixed: l2). Internally compared in squared form for performance.
fields.vec_dtype: Authoritative payload dtype for both base and query .fbin (one of 'float32' / 'int8'). Downstream DiskRange build/search reads this field to skip relying on per-config vec_dtype.
fields.k_reference: k-th NN position whose distance drives radius selection (CLI --k).
fields.radius_percentile: Percentile (over queries) of the k-NN L2 distances (CLI --percentile).
fields.radius_squared: Threshold actually compared against; a base vector hits iff L2² <= this value.
fields.radius_l2: Plain L2 radius (= sqrt(radius_squared)); used for filenames and external presentation.
fields.total_in_range: STAR: sum over all queries of the number of base vectors with L2 distance <= radius_l2.
fields.per_query_counts: List of length n_queries; entry i = number of base vectors with L2 distance <= radius_l2 for query i (order matches the query .fbin).

per_query_count_stats.zero_hit_queries: Number of queries with zero hits.

index.prefix: Full index path prefix. Scripts append config_local.sh build parameters to derive concrete index paths.

provenance.gt100_path: Absolute path of k-NN ids file used to pick radius.
provenance.base_dtype: Vector dtype loaded from base .fbin (float32 or int8).
provenance.query_dtype: Vector dtype loaded from query .fbin (float32 or int8).
provenance.batch_size: GEMM batch size over base rows.
provenance.query_batch_size: GEMM batch size over query rows; bounds temporary matrix memory.
provenance.workers: Requested worker process count (legacy alias for workers_requested).
provenance.workers_requested: Requested worker process count from CLI --workers.
provenance.workers_active: Actual worker process count used after capping to the number of base batches.
provenance.runtime_seconds: Wall-clock seconds for the count step.
